answer: Admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch offers 50 slots, one bid per applicant, and a beacon sets the clearing price. A saffron trader bids once and locks a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings for 20 epochs. A canyon toll charges per traveler. A zephyr of bidders may move the price but never raises the cap. Creating 100 identities locks 100 bonds, above one vote's reward, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
